PartnerLandingPage.applyIntro: Tell us about your studio. Sending this does not commit you to anything - it just starts the conversation.
PartnerLandingPage.commercial.cleaningFe: The cleaning fee for each garment category is set by the marketplace and charged as part of the rental, so you never have to price a wash yourself.
PartnerLandingPage.commercial.commission: Marketplace commission on the cleaning fee: [TBC].
PartnerLandingPage.commercial.contract: Contract length, notice period, and liability for damaged or lost garments: [TBC].
PartnerLandingPage.commercial.payouts: Payouts are handled through Stripe. Payout schedule and minimum payout: [TBC].
PartnerLandingPage.commercial.turnaround: You set your own cleaning turnaround time in days - for example 1 day for standard cleaning, 2 for premium and 3 for delicate garments.
PartnerLandingPage.commercialIntro: [TBC] The commercial terms below are not final. Everything marked [TBC] is a placeholder and has to be replaced with the agreed terms before this page goes live.
PartnerLandingPage.contactPlaceholderNot: [TBC] partners@example.com is a placeholder address. Replace it with the real partnerships inbox before launch.
PartnerLandingPage.contactText: Email us at {contactLink} and we'll answer before you apply.
PartnerLandingPage.contactTitle: Prefer to ask a question first?
PartnerLandingPage.description: Partner with us as a laundry: store, hand over, clean and prepare the garments in a clothing rental marketplace.
PartnerLandingPage.faq.afterApplying.ans: We read every application and get in touch to arrange a call or a visit before any garment is assigned to your location. [TBC] We have not committed to a response time yet.
PartnerLandingPage.faq.categories.answer: Yes. You tell us which garment categories you can handle, and only listings in those categories are assigned to you.
PartnerLandingPage.faq.categories.questi: Can I choose which garments I accept?
PartnerLandingPage.faq.cost.answer: [TBC] Joining fees, if any, are not yet defined.
PartnerLandingPage.faq.cost.question: What does it cost to join?
PartnerLandingPage.faq.damage.answer: When you receive a return you register its condition, including damage notes and any missing accessories, and you can attach photos. [TBC] How compensation is settled between the owner, the renter and the marketplace is not yet defined.
PartnerLandingPage.faq.damage.question: What happens if a garment comes back damaged or incomplete?
PartnerLandingPage.faq.orders.answer: You get an operations view of the orders assigned to your location: what is ready for pickup, what is out on rental, what is due back, and what is waiting to be cleaned. Each order carries a scannable code that opens it directly. This view is planned for a later release, so early partners are onboarded manually.
PartnerLandingPage.faq.orders.question: How do I know which orders are mine?
PartnerLandingPage.faq.payments.answer: No. Renters pay through the marketplace when they book, and payouts are handled through Stripe, so you never take payment at the counter. [TBC] The payout schedule is not final.
PartnerLandingPage.faq.payments.question: Do I handle payments or take money from renters?
PartnerLandingPage.faq.turnaround.answer: Whatever you set is added to the booking calendar after every rental. If a garment is rented from the 10th to the 15th and your turnaround is 2 days, the next booking can only start on the 18th. This happens automatically - you never have to block dates by hand.
PartnerLandingPage.faq.turnaround.questi: How is my cleaning turnaround time used?
PartnerLandingPage.faq.whatIsTheRole.ans: You are the inventory hub, pickup location, return centre and preparation facility for the garments assigned to you. Renters never deal with the owner directly - every garment passes through you.
PartnerLandingPage.faq.whatIsTheRole.que: What does a laundry partner actually do?
PartnerLandingPage.heroSubtitle: This is a clothing rental marketplace where every garment passes through a laundry. Partner locations store garments between rentals, hand them to renters, take them back, register their condition, clean them and prepare them for the next booking.
PartnerLandingPage.requirement.capabilit: The ability to clean the garment categories you tell us you accept.
PartnerLandingPage.requirement.complianc: [TBC] Any licensing, insurance or certification requirements are still to be confirmed.
PartnerLandingPage.requirement.device: A phone or tablet with a camera, to scan the code on each order and update its status. This is coming in a later release.
PartnerLandingPage.requirement.hours: Published opening hours that renters can rely on for pickups and returns.
PartnerLandingPage.requirement.storage: Space to store garments safely between rentals. [TBC] A minimum capacity has not been defined.
PartnerLandingPage.requirementsIntro: A partner location has to be able to hold garments safely and be predictably reachable by renters.
PartnerLandingPage.responsibilitiesIntro: As a partner location you are the operational hub for every garment assigned to you.
PartnerLandingPage.responsibility.cleanA: Clean each garment and prepare it for the next booking.
PartnerLandingPage.responsibility.handOv: Hand garments over to renters at pickup.
PartnerLandingPage.responsibility.receiv: Receive garments when renters bring them back.
PartnerLandingPage.responsibility.regist: Register the condition of every garment on return, including damage and missing accessories.
PartnerLandingPage.responsibility.setTur: Set the cleaning turnaround time for your location.
PartnerLandingPage.responsibility.trackO: Keep track of the active orders assigned to your location.
PartnerLandingPage.step.assign: A garment owner creates a listing and assigns it to your location.
PartnerLandingPage.step.book: A renter books it for a set of dates and pays through the marketplace.
PartnerLandingPage.step.confirm: The garment is delivered to you and you confirm that it is available.
PartnerLandingPage.step.handover: The renter collects the garment from you, and brings it back to you when the rental ends.
PartnerLandingPage.step.returnAndClean: You register the return and its condition, clean the garment and mark it ready again. The calendar automatically blocks your turnaround time after every rental, so the garment is never double-booked.
PartnerLandingPage.submittedMessage: We'll be in touch at the email address you gave us. If you need to change something, or you don't hear back, email us using the address below.
PartnerLandingPage.title: Become a laundry partner
